html_before:
Availability of tax information

While the CRA works to process tax slips and make them available as they are received, it is possible that your slips may not currently be available in your CRA account or through the Auto-fill my return service. If you have not yet filed your 2024 tax return and do not see a slip in your CRA account, we recommend using the slip provided by the issuer (e.g. your financial institution or employer).
html_after:
Availability of tax information

If you do not see a tax slip in your CRA account when you are filing your 2024 tax return, use the slip provided by the issuer (for example, your financial institution or employer). TFSA information is now available in your CRA account, but it is important to keep your own records to avoid overcontributing.
